## Age and Gender

### Age distribution

```{r age_group, include = F}
# Calculate age group counts and percentages
age_count <- df %>%
  count(age_group, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = 100 * n / sum(n),
    pct_label = sprintf("%.1f%%", percentage),
    label = pct_label,
    label_color = if_else(percentage >= 15, "white", "black")
  )

# Total number of surgeons
total_age_n <- sum(age_count$n, na.rm = TRUE)

# Graph barplot
age_group_bar <- age_count %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = age_group,
    y = n,
    fill = n
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label, color = label_color),
    vjust = 1.5,
    size = 3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_fill_distiller(
    palette = "YlOrRd",
    direction = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Age Groups",
    x = "Age Group",
    y = "Number of Surgeons"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
```

### Participant Characteristic Table

```{r}
# Section one (header)
.build_section <- function(df, var, section_label, digits = 1,
                           include_na_row = FALSE, na_label = "Not reported/applicable") {
  v <- df[[var]]

  # normalize to character; treat blanks as NA
  v_chr <- if (is.factor(v)) as.character(v) else as.character(v)
  v_chr <- ifelse(str_trim(v_chr) == "", NA_character_, v_chr)

  # denominator: non-missing values in this section
  denom <- sum(!is.na(v_chr))

  # counts for non-missing
  items <- tibble(value = v_chr)  %>% 
    filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
    count(value, name = "n") %>%
    arrange(desc(n), value) %>%
    mutate(
      pct = n / denom,
      display = sprintf("%s (%s)", n, percent(pct, accuracy = 10^-digits)),
      row_type = "item",
      label = as.character(value)
    ) %>%
    select(row_type, label, display)

  # optional NA row (excluded from denominator)
  if (include_na_row && any(is.na(v_chr))) {
    na_n <- sum(is.na(v_chr))
    items <- bind_rows(
      items,
      tibble(
        row_type = "item",
        label = na_label,
        display = sprintf("%s (%s)", na_n, percent(na_n / (denom + na_n), accuracy = 10^-digits))
      )
    )
  }

  # section header row
  header <- tibble(
    row_type = "section",
    label    = sprintf("%s, n (%%)", section_label),
    display  = sprintf("N = %s studies", comma(denom))
  )

  bind_rows(header, items)
}

# ----- Build the whole profile table 
make_profile_table_gt <- function(
  df,
  sections = c(
    age_group             = "Age Group",
    gender                = "Gender",
    country_practice      = "Country of Practice"
  ),
  digits = 1,
  include_na_row = FALSE,      # set TRUE if you want an explicit NA row per section
  title = "Participant demographics",# table title (left)
  overall_n_right = TRUE       # show overall N on the far right of the table title
) {
  # assemble all sections (stacked)
  body <- map2_dfr(names(sections), unname(sections), ~
    .build_section(df, var = .x, section_label = .y, digits = digits, include_na_row = include_na_row)
  )

  # little helper for visual indent
  body <- body %>%
    mutate(
      Label = ifelse(row_type == "item", paste0("  ", label), label),
      `n (%)` = display
    ) %>%
    select(Label, `n (%)`, row_type)

  # overall N (optional, in the title area)
  overall_tag <- if (overall_n_right) paste0("N = ", scales::comma(nrow(df)), " studies") else NULL

  gt_tbl <- body %>%
    gt() %>%
    cols_hide(columns = row_type) %>%
    tab_header(
      title = md(title),
      subtitle = overall_tag
    ) %>%
    # style section header rows
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold")),
      locations = cells_body(rows = row_type == "section", columns = "Label")
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold"), cell_text(align = "right")),
      locations = cells_body(rows = row_type == "section", columns = "n (%)")
    ) %>%
    # add subtle indentation to item rows
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(indent = px(12)),
      locations = cells_body(rows = row_type == "item", columns = "Label")
    ) %>%
    # thin row separators between sections
    tab_options(
      table.font.size = px(13),
      data_row.padding = px(6),
      table.border.top.color = "grey70",
      table.border.top.width = px(1),
      table.border.bottom.color = "grey70",
      table.border.bottom.width = px(1)
    ) %>%
    # draw a light rule above each new section
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_borders(sides = "top", color = "grey85", weight = px(1))),
      locations = cells_body(rows = row_type == "section")
    ) %>%
    cols_label(Label = md(""), `n (%)` = md(""))

  gt_tbl
}

# Make table using gt 
gt_table <- make_profile_table_gt(
  df,
  sections = c(
    # add more or reorder as you like:
    age_group             = "Patients (age groups)",
    gender                = "Patients Gender",
    country_practice      = "Country of Practice"
  ),
  digits = 1,
  include_na_row = FALSE,
  title = "Participant Characteristics",
  overall_n_right = TRUE
)

gt_table
```

### Demographic Pyramid

```{r demo_pyramid include=F}
# Calculate counts and percentages by age group and gender
pyramid_data <- df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(age_group),
    !is.na(gender),
    gender %in% c("Male", "Female")
  ) %>%
  count(age_group, gender, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = 100 * n / sum(n),
    plot_n = if_else(
      gender == "Male",
      -n,
      n
    ),
    pct_label = sprintf("%.1f%%", percentage)
  )

# Create demographic pyramid
demographic_pyramid <- pyramid_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = age_group,
    y = plot_n,
    fill = gender
  )) +
  geom_col(width = 0.85) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = pct_label,
      hjust = if_else(plot_n < 0, 1.1, -0.1)
    ),
    size = 5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) abs(x),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.15)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Male" = "darkred",
      "Female" = "orange"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Age and Gender Distribution of Surgeons",
    x = "Age Group",
    y = "Number of Surgeons",
    fill = "Gender"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )
```

## Country of practice

### Prep country data

```{r prep_country_practice include=F}
# View the countries
# unique(df$country_currently)
# unique(df$country_practice)

# Extract unique countries from each column
clean_country_practice <- df %>% 
  separate_rows(country_currently, sep = ";") %>% 
  mutate(country_currently = str_trim(country_currently))

# Build a vector of valid country names using the countrycode package
valid_countries <- unique(countrycode::codelist$country.name.en)  # Standard country name

# Count respondents by country
country_counts <- clean_country_practice %>% 
  mutate(
    iso_a3 = case_when(
      country_currently == "cote_divoire" ~ "CIV",
      country_currently == "democratic_republic_of_the_congo" ~ "COD",
      TRUE ~ countrycode(
        str_replace_all(country_currently, "_", " "),
        origin = "country.name",
        destination = "iso3c"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(iso_a3)) %>%
  count(country_currently, iso_a3, name = "country_count") %>%
  arrange(desc(country_count))

# Retrieve African country boundaries
africa <- ne_countries(
  continent = "Africa",
  scale = "medium",
  returnclass = "sf"
)

# Join survey counts to map
africa_data <- africa %>%
  left_join(
    country_counts,
    by = c("adm0_a3" = "iso_a3")
  )

```

### Create Top 5 Countries Barplot

```{r coutry_plot include=F}
# Calculate total number of country counts
total_n <- sum(country_counts$country_count, na.rm = TRUE)

# Create the count table 
bar_df_top5 <- country_counts %>%
  arrange(desc(country_count), iso_a3) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage  = 100 * country_count / total_n,
    pct_label   = sprintf("%.1f%%", percentage),
    # choose label color based on how dark the bar will be
    label_color = if_else(percentage >= 12, "white", "black")  # tweak threshold if needed
  )

barplot_choro <- bar_df_top5 %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = reorder(country_currently, percentage),
    y = percentage, fill = percentage)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  # place text just inside the right edge; color varies by bar brightness
  geom_text(aes(label = pct_label, color = label_color),
            hjust = 0.98, vjust = 0.5, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "YlOrRd")) +
  scale_color_identity() +  # use the colors already in the data
  scale_x_discrete(
  labels = stringr::str_to_title) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(title = "Top 5 Contributors to Total PRS") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks  = element_blank(),
    axis.title  = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid  = element_blank(),
    plot.title.position = "plot",                 # <-- anchor to plot left edge
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 6))
  )

barplot_choro
```

### Create Choropleth

```{r choropleth include=F}

    data = africa,

    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
```

## Years in Practice

### Histogram

```{r yrs_practice include=F}
# Prep data
practice_df <- df %>% 
  filter(
    !is.na(year_prs_accredited),
    year_prs_accredited >= 0,
    year_prs_accredited < 50
  )

# Calculate median
median_practice <- median(practice_df$year_prs_accredited)

# Create histogram of years in practice
yrs_practice <- practice_df %>% 
  
  ggplot(aes(
    x = year_prs_accredited,
    fill = after_stat(count)
    )) +
    
  # Histogram
  geom_histogram(
    aes(fill = after_stat(count)),
    binwidth = 1,
    boundary = 0,
    color = "white",
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
    
  # Kernel density curve
  geom_density(
    aes(y = after_stat(density * n * 1)),
    color = "grey",
    linewidth = 0.75,
    adjust = 1,
    fill = NA
  )  +
  
  # Median years
  geom_vline(
  xintercept = median(
   df$year_prs_accredited,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  linetype = "dashed",
  color = "#C0392B",
  linewidth = 0.8
 ) +
    
  # Frequency labels above bars
  geom_text(
  stat = "bin",
  binwidth = 1,
  boundary = 0,
  aes(label = ifelse(
    after_stat(count) > 0,
    paste0("n = ", after_stat(count)),
    "")),
  vjust = -1,
  size = 2.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_distiller(
    palette = "YlOrRd",
    direction = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Years Since Specialty Accreditation",
    x = "Years Since Specialty Accreditation",
    y = "Number of Surgeons",
    caption = paste0(
      "Grey solid curve: kernel density estimate (scaled to frequency). ",
      "Red dashed line: median (",
      round(median_practice, 1),
      " years)."
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,25, by = 5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,20, by = 5)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.4)
  )
```

## Professional Training Background

```{r professional_table include=F}
# Group specialty accreditation years
training_df <- df %>% 
  mutate(
    accreditation_year_group = case_when(
      as.numeric(as.character(accreditation_year)) < 2000 ~ "Pre-2000",
      between(as.numeric(as.character(accreditation_year)), 2000, 2009) ~ "2000-2009",
      between(as.numeric(as.character(accreditation_year)), 2010, 2019) ~ "2010-2019",
      as.numeric(as.character(accreditation_year)) >= 2020 ~ "2020+",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    accreditation_year_group = factor(
      accreditation_year_group,
      levels = c(
        "Pre-2000",
        "2000-2009",
        "2010-2019",
        "2020+"
      )
    )
  )

# Build individual sections
.build_training_section <- function(
  df,
  var,
  section_label,
  digits = 1,
  include_na_row = FALSE
) {

  v <- as.character(df[[var]])
  v <- na_if(str_trim(v), "")

  denom <- sum(!is.na(v))

  items <- tibble(value = v) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  count(value, name = "N") %>%
  mutate(
    Percent = round(100 * N / denom, digits),
    row_type = "item",
    Label = value
  ) %>%
  select(row_type, Label, N, Percent)

  # Sort accreditation years chronologically
  if (var == "accreditation_year_group") {
    items <- items %>%
      arrange(match(
        Label,
        c("Pre-2000", "2000-2009", "2010-2019", "2020+")
      ))
  } else {
    items <- items %>%
      arrange(desc(N), Label)
  }

  # Optional missing-value row
  if (include_na_row && any(is.na(v))) {
    na_n <- sum(is.na(v))

    items <- bind_rows(
      items,
      tibble(
        row_type = "item",
        Label = "Not reported/applicable",
        N = na_n,
        Percent = round(100 * na_n / length(v), digits)
      )
    )
  }

  header <- tibble(
    row_type = "section",
    Label = section_label,
    N = denom,
    Percent = NA_real_
  )

  bind_rows(header, items)
}


# Build complete professional training table
make_training_table_gt <- function(
  df,
  sections = c(
    qualification = "Highest Qualification",
    accreditation_body = "Primary Accreditation Body",
    accreditation_year_group = "Year of Specialty Accreditation"
  ),
  digits = 1,
  include_na_row = FALSE,
  title = "Professional Training Background"
) {

  body <- map2_dfr(
    names(sections),
    unname(sections),
    ~ .build_training_section(
      df,
      var = .x,
      section_label = .y,
      digits = digits,
      include_na_row = include_na_row
    )
  )

  gt_tbl <- body %>%
    gt() %>%
    cols_hide(columns = row_type) %>%
    tab_header(
      title = md(paste0("**", title, "**")),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Total sample: N = ",
        scales::comma(nrow(df))
      )
    ) %>%
    cols_label(
      Label = "Characteristic",
      N = "N",
      Percent = "%"
    ) %>%
    fmt_number(
      columns = Percent,
      decimals = digits
    ) %>%
    sub_missing(
      columns = Percent,
      missing_text = ""
    ) %>%
    fmt_number(
      columns = N,
      decimals = 0,
      use_seps = TRUE
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_body(
        rows = row_type == "section"
      )
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(indent = px(12)),
      locations = cells_body(
        rows = row_type == "item",
        columns = Label
      )
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_borders(
        sides = "top",
        color = "grey85",
        weight = px(1)
      ),
      locations = cells_body(
        rows = row_type == "section"
      )
    ) %>%
    cols_align(
      align = "right",
      columns = c(N, Percent)
    ) %>%
    tab_options(
      table.font.size = px(13),
      data_row.padding = px(6),
      table.border.top.color = "grey70",
      table.border.top.width = px(1),
      table.border.bottom.color = "grey70",
      table.border.bottom.width = px(1)
    )

  gt_tbl
}
```

```{r barplot_function include=F}
# Reusable bar plot function
create_barplot <- function(data, variable, title) {
  
  data %>% 
    count({{variable}}) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(
      x = {{variable}},
      y = n,
      fill = n
    )) + 
    geom_col() +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = paste0("n = ", n)),
      vjust = 1.5,
      size = 3
      ) +
    scale_fill_distiller(
      palette = "YlOrRd",
      direction = 1
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title, 
      x = NULL, 
      y = "Number of Surgeons"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
}
```

```{r facility_table include=F}
# Section one (header)
.build_section <- function(df, var, section_label, digits = 1,
                           include_na_row = FALSE, na_label = "Not reported/applicable") {
  v <- df[[var]]

  # normalize to character; treat blanks as NA
  v_chr <- if (is.factor(v)) as.character(v) else as.character(v)
  v_chr <- ifelse(str_trim(v_chr) == "", NA_character_, v_chr)

  # denominator: non-missing values in this section
  denom <- sum(!is.na(v_chr))

  # counts for non-missing
  items <- tibble(value = v_chr)  %>% 
    filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
    count(value, name = "n") %>%
    arrange(desc(n), value) %>%
    mutate(
      pct = n / denom,
      display = sprintf("%s (%s)", n, percent(pct, accuracy = 10^-digits)),
      row_type = "item",
      label = as.character(value)
    ) %>%
    select(row_type, label, display)

  # optional NA row (excluded from denominator)
  if (include_na_row && any(is.na(v_chr))) {
    na_n <- sum(is.na(v_chr))
    items <- bind_rows(
      items,
      tibble(
        row_type = "item",
        label = na_label,
        display = sprintf("%s (%s)", na_n, percent(na_n / (denom + na_n), accuracy = 10^-digits))
      )
    )
  }

  # section header row
  header <- tibble(
    row_type = "section",
    label    = sprintf("%s, n (%%)", section_label),
    display = sprintf("N = %s facilities", comma(denom))
  )

  bind_rows(header, items)
}

# ----- Build the whole profile table 
make_facility_gt <- function(
  df,
  sections = c(
    facility_location_type             = "Urban vs. Rural",
    facility_level                = "Level of Health Facility",
    facility_ownership      = "Facility Ownership Type"
  ),
  digits = 1,
  include_na_row = FALSE,      # set TRUE if you want an explicit NA row per section
  title = "Facility Characteristics",# table title (left)
  overall_n_right = TRUE       # show overall N on the far right of the table title
) {
  # assemble all sections (stacked)
  body <- map2_dfr(names(sections), unname(sections), ~
    .build_section(df, var = .x, section_label = .y, digits = digits, include_na_row = include_na_row)
  )

  # little helper for visual indent
  body <- body %>%
    mutate(
      Label = ifelse(row_type == "item", paste0("  ", label), label),
      `n (%)` = display
    ) %>%
    select(Label, `n (%)`, row_type)

  # overall N (optional, in the title area)
  overall_tag <- if (overall_n_right) {
  paste0("N = ", scales::comma(nrow(df)), " facilities")
} else {
  NULL
}
  gt_tbl <- body %>%
    gt() %>%
    cols_hide(columns = row_type) %>%
    tab_header(
      title = md(title),
      subtitle = overall_tag
    ) %>%
    # style section header rows
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold")),
      locations = cells_body(rows = row_type == "section", columns = "Label")
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold"), cell_text(align = "right")),
      locations = cells_body(rows = row_type == "section", columns = "n (%)")
    ) %>%
    # add subtle indentation to item rows
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(indent = px(12)),
      locations = cells_body(rows = row_type == "item", columns = "Label")
    ) %>%
    # thin row separators between sections
    tab_options(
      table.font.size = px(13),
      data_row.padding = px(6),
      table.border.top.color = "grey70",
      table.border.top.width = px(1),
      table.border.bottom.color = "grey70",
      table.border.bottom.width = px(1)
    ) %>%
    # draw a light rule above each new section
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_borders(sides = "top", color = "grey85", weight = px(1))),
      locations = cells_body(rows = row_type == "section")
    ) %>%
    cols_label(Label = md(""), `n (%)` = md(""))

  gt_tbl
}

)
```

# WORKFORCE PROFILE

## Staffing Numbers per Facility

```{r}
# Create function
format_staffing <- function(x) {

  # Remove missing values
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]

  # If all values are missing
  if (length(x) == 0) return("NR")

  # If only one respondent reported a value
  if (length(x) == 1) {
    return(as.character(x))
  }

  # If multiple respondents reported values
  median_value <- median(x)
  min_value <- min(x)
  max_value <- max(x)

  # If all respondents agree, show only the value
  if (min_value == max_value) {
    return(as.character(median_value))
  }

  # Otherwise, show median (minimum–maximum)
  paste0(
    median_value,
    " (", min_value, "–", max_value, ")"
  )
}

# Facility-level staffing summary
facility_staffing <- facility_df %>%
  group_by(facility_country, facility_name) %>%
  summarise(
    n_respondents = n(),

    prs_surgeons = format_staffing(num_prs_surgeons),
    prs_trainees = format_staffing(num_prs_trainees),
    ot_nurses = format_staffing(num_ot_nurses),
    physiotherapists = format_staffing(num_physiotherapists),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(facility_country, facility_name)

# Create table grouped by country
facility_staffing %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "facility_country") %>%
  cols_label(
    facility_name = "Facility",
    n_respondents = "Respondents (n)",
    prs_surgeons = "PRS surgeons",
    prs_trainees = "PRS trainees",
    ot_nurses = "OT nurses",
    physiotherapists = "Physiotherapists"
  ) %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Reported Surgical Workforce by Facility and Country",
    subtitle = "Facility-level workforce estimates"
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = -facility_name
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_row_groups()
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(12),
    data_row.padding = px(5),
    row_group.font.weight = "bold",
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold"
  ) %>%
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = paste(
      "For facilities with multiple valid reports,",
      "values represent median (minimum–maximum).",
```

```{r}
facility_emergency <- facility_df %>%

  ) %>%

  summarise(
    facility_level = first(na.omit(facility_level),
                           default = NA_character_),

    facility_location_type = first(
      na.omit(facility_location_type),
      default = NA_character_
    ),

    emergency_coverage = case_when(
      all(is.na(emergency_24hr)) ~ NA_character_,
      n_distinct(emergency_24hr, na.rm = TRUE) > 1 ~ "Conflicting",
      TRUE ~ first(na.omit(emergency_24hr))
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Keep facilities with valid Yes/No responses
emergency_df <- facility_emergency %>%
  filter(emergency_coverage %in% c("Yes", "No"))

# Function to calculate N (%)
summarize_coverage <- function(data, group_var, group_label) {

  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[group_var]])) %>%
    group_by(
      group = .data[[group_var]],
      emergency_coverage
    ) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    complete(
      group,
      emergency_coverage = c("Yes", "No"),
      fill = list(n = 0)
    ) %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    mutate(
      pct = 100 * n / sum(n),
      value = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, pct),
      column = paste(group_label, group)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(emergency_coverage, column, value)
}

overall <- emergency_df %>%
  count(emergency_coverage, name = "n") %>%
  complete(
    emergency_coverage = c("Yes", "No"),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct = 100 * n / sum(n),
    value = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, pct),
    column = "Overall"
  ) %>%
  select(emergency_coverage, column, value)

by_level <- summarize_coverage(
  emergency_df,
  "facility_level",
  "Level:"
)

by_location <- summarize_coverage(
  emergency_df,
  "facility_location_type",
  "Location:"
)

table_5_2 <- bind_rows(
  overall,
  by_level,
  by_location
) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = column,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    emergency_coverage = factor(
      emergency_coverage,
      levels = c("Yes", "No")
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(emergency_coverage) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Table 5.2. Emergency PRS Coverage**"),
    subtitle = "Overall and by facility characteristics"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    emergency_coverage = "Emergency PRS Coverage"
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = -emergency_coverage
  ) %>%
  tab_source_note(
    md(
      "*Values are n (%). Percentages are calculated within each group. Facilities with unresolved or missing Q28 responses are excluded.*"
    )
  ) %>%
  opt_row_striping()
```

# SERVICE DELIVERY

## Scope of Procedure Performed

### Heatmap

```{r heatmap include=F}
# Create list of variables
procedure_vars <- names(df)[84:101]

response_levels <- c(
  "routinely",
  "occasionally",
  "rarely",
  "not_performed"
)

# Custom procedure labels
procedure_labels <- c(
  "wound_debridement"     = "Wound Debridement",
  "skin_lesion_excision"  = "Skin Lesion Excision",
  "burn_excision"         = "Burn Excision",
  "burn_reconstruction"   = "Burn Reconstruction",
  "contracture_release"   = "Contracture Release",
  "skin_substitute_app"   = "Skin Substitute Application",
  "stsg"                  = "Split-Thickness Skin Graft",
  "ftsg"                  = "Full-Thickness Skin Graft",
  "local_pedicled_flaps"  = "Local/Pedicled Flaps",
  "microvascular_surgery" = "Microvascular Surgery",
  "hand_surgery_proc"     = "Hand Surgery Procedures",
  "tendon_repair"         = "Tendon Repair",
  "amputation"            = "Amputation",
  "cleft_lip_repair"      = "Cleft Lip Repair",
  "cleft_palate_repair"   = "Cleft Palate Repair",
  "craniofacial_recon"    = "Craniofacial Reconstruction",
  "breast_reconstruction" = "Breast Reconstruction",
  "cosmetic_surgery"      = "Cosmetic Surgery"
)

service_long <- df %>%
  select(all_of(procedure_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "procedure",
    values_to = "frequency"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    frequency = str_squish(as.character(frequency)),
    frequency = case_when(
      str_to_lower(frequency) == "performed occasionally" ~
        "Occasionally performed",
      TRUE ~ frequency
    ),
    frequency = factor(
      frequency,
      levels = response_levels
    )
  )

```

```{r calculate_heatmap include=F}
# Calculate the heatmap percentages
heatmap_data <- service_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(frequency)) %>%
  count(procedure, frequency, name = "n") %>%
  complete(
    procedure,
    frequency = factor(
      response_levels,
      levels = response_levels
    ),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(procedure) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    percent = if_else(
      total > 0,
      100 * n / total,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Order procedures by % routinely performed
procedure_order <- heatmap_data %>%
  filter(frequency == "routinely") %>%
  arrange(desc(percent)) %>%
  pull(procedure)

heatmap_data <- heatmap_data %>%
  mutate(
    procedure = factor(
      procedure,
      levels = rev(procedure_order)
    )
  )


```

```{r calculate_percentage include=F}
# Calculate heatmap percentages by country
heatmap_country <- service_long_country %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(facility_country),
    !is.na(procedure),
    !is.na(frequency)
  ) %>%
  count(
    facility_country,
    procedure,
    frequency,
    name = "n",
    .drop = FALSE
  ) %>%
  group_by(facility_country, procedure) %>%
  complete(
    frequency = factor(
      response_levels,
      levels = response_levels,
      ordered = TRUE
    ),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    percent = if_else(
      total > 0,
      100 * n / total,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(total > 0)

# Sort procedures by overall % routinely performed
# Only include respondents with a matched country
procedure_order <- service_long_country %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(facility_country),
    !is.na(procedure),
    !is.na(frequency)
  ) %>%
  group_by(procedure) %>%
  summarise(
    pct_routine = 100 * mean(
      frequency == "Routinely performed"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_routine)) %>%
  pull(procedure)

# Apply the same ordering to every country
heatmap_country <- heatmap_country %>%
  mutate(
    procedure = factor(
      as.character(procedure),
      levels = rev(procedure_order)
    ),
    frequency = factor(
      as.character(frequency),
      levels = response_levels,
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r create_heatmap echo=F}
# Function to create country-specific heatmaps
plot_country_heatmap <- function(country_name) {
  country_data <- heatmap_country %>%
    filter(facility_country == country_name)
  
  if (nrow(country_data) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No data found for", country_name))
  }
  
  # Count unique surgeons with at least one valid response
  n_surgeons <- service_long_country %>%
    filter(facility_country == country_name, !is.na(frequency)) %>%
    summarise(n = n_distinct(id)) %>%
    pull(n)
  
  ggplot(country_data, aes(x = frequency, y = procedure, fill = percent)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(
      label = sprintf("%.1f%%", percent),
      color = case_when(percent == 0 ~ "grey50", 
                        percent >= 50 ~ "white", 
                        TRUE ~ "black")
    ),
    size = 3.5,
    show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("white", RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "YlOrRd")),
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
    labels = function(x)
      paste0(x, "%"),
    name = "Respondents (%)"
  ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      labels = c("Routinely", "Occasionally", "Rarely", "Not performed"),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(
      labels = function(x) {
        dplyr::coalesce(unname(procedure_labels[x]), x)
      }
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Scope of Procedures Performed —", country_name),
      subtitle = "Surgeon-reported procedural frequency",
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      caption = paste0("N = ", n_surgeons, " surgeons. ")
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.caption = element_text(
        hjust = 0,
        size = 9,
        color = "gray40"
      ),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}
```

```{r surgical_volume_table include=F}
.build_volume_section <- function(
    df,
    var,
    section_label,
    digits = 1
) {

  v <- df[[var]]
  volume_levels <- levels(v)
  denom <- nrow(df)

  items <- tibble(value = v) %>%
    count(value, name = "n", .drop = FALSE) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
    mutate(
      pct = if (denom > 0) n / denom else NA_real_,
      row_type = "item",
      label = as.character(value),
      display_n = scales::comma(n),
      display_pct = ifelse(
        is.na(pct),
        "—",
        scales::percent(pct, accuracy = 10^-digits)
      )
    ) %>%
    select(row_type, label, display_n, display_pct)

  header <- tibble(
    row_type = "section",
    label = sprintf(
      "%s (N = %s)",
      section_label,
      scales::comma(denom)
    ),
    display_n = "",
    display_pct = ""
  )

  bind_rows(header, items)
}

make_surgical_volume_table_gt <- function(
    df,
    volume_var = "annual_recon_volume",
    country_var = "surgeon_country",        # <-- updated default
    digits = 1,
    title = "Annual Reconstructive Procedure Volume"
) {

  required_vars <- c(volume_var, country_var)

  if (!all(required_vars %in% names(df))) {
    stop("Check volume_var and country_var column names.")
  }

  overall_section <- .build_volume_section(
    df = df,
    var = volume_var,
    section_label = "Overall",
    digits = digits
  )

  country_sections <- df %>%
    mutate(
      .country = str_trim(
        as.character(.data[[country_var]])
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.country), .country != "") %>%
    group_split(.country) %>%
    map_dfr(function(country_df) {
      country_name <- country_df$.country[1]
      .build_volume_section(
        df = country_df,
        var = volume_var,
        section_label = country_name,
        digits = digits
      )
    })

  body <- bind_rows(
    overall_section,
    country_sections
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Label = label,
      `N surgeons` = display_n,
      `%` = display_pct
    ) %>%
    select(Label, `N surgeons`, `%`, row_type)

  gt_tbl <- body %>%
    gt() %>%

    cols_hide(columns = row_type) %>%

    tab_header(
      title = md(paste0("**", title, "**")),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Total surgeons surveyed: N = ",
        comma(nrow(df))
      )
    ) %>%

    cols_label(
      Label = "Annual procedure volume",
      `N surgeons` = "N surgeons",
      `%` = "%"
    ) %>%

    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_body(rows = row_type == "section")
    ) %>%

    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(indent = px(12)),
      locations = cells_body(
        rows = row_type == "item",
        columns = Label
      )
    ) %>%

    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "#F2F4F6"),
      locations = cells_body(rows = row_type == "section")
    ) %>%

    tab_style(
      style = cell_borders(
        sides = "top",
        color = "grey80",
        weight = px(1)
      ),
      locations = cells_body(rows = row_type == "section")
    ) %>%

    cols_align(
      align = "right",
      columns = c(`N surgeons`, `%`)    # <-- fixed from `N facilities`
    ) %>%

    tab_options(
      table.font.size = px(13),
      data_row.padding = px(6),
      heading.align = "left",
      column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
      table.border.top.color = "grey70",
      table.border.top.width = px(1),
      table.border.bottom.color = "grey70",
      table.border.bottom.width = px(1)
    ) %>%

    tab_source_note(
      source_note = md(
        "*Percentages are based on surgeons with valid responses within each country."  # <-- fixed
      )
    )

  return(gt_tbl)
}

```

```{r prepare_workload include=F}
# Prepare workload categories

# Total surgeons with valid workload responses
total_respondents <- df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(workload_categories),
    str_trim(as.character(workload_categories)) != ""
  ) %>%
  nrow()

# Separate multiple selections into individual rows
workload_df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    respondent_id = row_number(),
    workload_categories = as.character(workload_categories)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(workload_categories),
    str_trim(workload_categories) != ""
  ) %>%
  separate_rows(
    workload_categories,
    sep = ";"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    workload_categories = str_trim(workload_categories)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    workload_categories != "",
    !is.na(workload_categories)
  ) %>%
  # Count each category once per surgeon
  distinct(respondent_id, workload_categories)

# Calculate frequencies and percentages
workload_count <- workload_df %>%
  count(
    workload_categories,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n), workload_categories) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = 100 * n / total_respondents,

    # Highlight the 3 most frequently selected categories
    rank = row_number(),

    highlight = if_else(
      rank <= 3,
      "Top 3 Categories",
      "Other Categories"
    ),

    # Label with frequency and percentage
    pct_label = sprintf(
      "%.1f%% (n = %s)",
      percentage,
      n
    )
  )
```

```{r workload_country_bar echo=F}
plot_country_workload <- function(country_name) {

    mutate(
```

```{r}
  group_by(facility_name) %>%
  summarise(
    n_countries = n_distinct(
      facility_country,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_countries > 1)

if (nrow(country_conflicts) > 0) {
  stop("Some facility names have conflicting countries.")
}

# Keep one country per facility, prioritizing non-missing

  arrange(facility_name, is.na(facility_country)) %>%
  distinct(facility_name, .keep_all = TRUE)

# 2. Add country to aggregated infrastructure data
# -------------------------------------------------------
```

```{r}

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Calculate readiness score for each facility
# -------------------------------------------------------

# Confirm infrastructure item count
length(infra_names)

# Prepare facility-item scores
infra_scores_long <- infra_facility_country %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(facility_country),
    facility_country != ""
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    readiness_point = case_when(
      availability == "consistently" ~ 2L,
      availability == "intermittently" ~ 1L,
      availability == "not_available" ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    facility_name,
    facility_country,
    item,
    readiness_point
  ) %>%
  group_by(facility_name, facility_country) %>%
  complete(item = infra_names) %>%
  ungroup()


# Calculate total score per facility
infra_readiness_facility <- infra_scores_long %>%
  group_by(
    facility_name,
    facility_country
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_consistently = sum(
      readiness_point == 1,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    n_classified = sum(!is.na(readiness_point)),

    n_missing = n_distinct(item) - n_classified,

    # Full 0-14 score only if all items classified
    readiness_score = if (
      n_classified == length(infra_names)
    ) {
      as.numeric(n_consistently)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    .groups = "drop"
  )

# View scores
infra_readiness_facility

```


```{r}

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Country-level mean and confidence intervals
# -------------------------------------------------------

infra_readiness_country <- infra_readiness_facility %>%
  group_by(facility_country) %>%
  summarise(
    n_facilities = sum(!is.na(readiness_score)),

    n_incomplete = sum(is.na(readiness_score)),

    mean_score = mean(
      readiness_score,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    sd_score = sd(
      readiness_score,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_score = if_else(
      is.nan(mean_score),
      NA_real_,
      mean_score
    ),

    # Standard error
    se = sd_score / sqrt(n_facilities),

    # 95% confidence interval
    t_value = if_else(
      n_facilities >= 2,
      qt(0.975, df = pmax(n_facilities - 1, 1)),
      NA_real_
    ),

    ci_lower = pmax(
      0,
      mean_score - t_value * se
    ),

    ci_upper = pmin(
  28,
  mean_score + t_value * se
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(n_facilities > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_score))

# View country summary
infra_readiness_country
```

### Infrastructure Readiness Score

A composite infrastructure readiness score was constructed using 14 infrastructure indicators. Each indicator was assigned an ordinal score based on surgeon-reported availability: 2 points for consistently available, 1 point for intermittently available, and 0 points for unavailable. The resulting composite score ranged from 0 to 28, with higher scores indicating greater reported infrastructure availability.

For facilities with multiple surgeon respondents, the modal response was used to determine item-level availability. Facilities with missing or tied modal responses for any infrastructure indicator were excluded from the complete-case readiness analysis. Mean facility-level scores were subsequently calculated by country.

The scoring system was designed as a descriptive, unweighted index of resource availability and was not considered a validated measure of surgical readiness.

### Infrastructure Readiness by Country

Infrastructure readiness varied across the 12 countries surveyed (Figure 7.2). The highest mean readiness score was observed in Rwanda (13.5 out of 14), followed by Kenya and Togo (12.0 each), and Uganda (11.0). Intermediate scores were observed in Nigeria (10.5), Somalia and Tanzania (10.0 each), and Ethiopia (9.0). Lower mean scores were observed in Côte d’Ivoire (8.0), Malawi (7.5), DR Congo (5.0), and Burundi (3.0).

However, the number of facilities contributing to country-level estimates varied considerably, ranging from one to six. Five countries were represented by only one facility, limiting the ability to assess within-country variability. Among countries with multiple facilities, wide 95% confidence intervals were observed in several cases, indicating substantial uncertainty around the estimated mean readiness scores.

Overall, these findings suggest heterogeneity in reported infrastructure availability across surveyed facilities, although the small and unequal country-level sample sizes limit broader comparisons of national infrastructure readiness.

### Heatmap by country and infrastructure

```{r}

# ============================================================
# FIGURE 7.3 — CONSISTENT INFRASTRUCTURE AVAILABILITY BY COUNTRY
# Facility-level modal surgeon responses
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define valid availability categories
# ------------------------------------------------------------

availability_levels <- c(
  "consistently",
  "intermittently",
  "not_available"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Prepare facility-level infrastructure data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

infra_valid <- infra_facility_country %>%
  mutate(
    facility_country = str_squish(
      as.character(facility_country)
    ),
    facility_name = str_squish(
      as.character(facility_name)
    ),
    availability = as.character(availability)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(facility_country),
    facility_country != "",
    !is.na(facility_name),
    facility_name != "",
    item %in% infra_names,
    availability %in% availability_levels
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    facility_country,
    facility_name,
    item,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Calculate consistent availability by country and item
# ------------------------------------------------------------

infra_country_heatmap <- infra_valid %>%
  group_by(facility_country, item) %>%
  summarise(
    n_facilities = n_distinct(facility_name),

    n_consistently = n_distinct(
      facility_name[availability == "consistently"]
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Complete all country-infrastructure combinations
all_countries <- infra_facility_country %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(facility_country),
    str_squish(as.character(facility_country)) != ""
  ) %>%
  pull(facility_country) %>%
  as.character() %>%
  str_squish() %>%
  unique()

infra_country_heatmap <- infra_country_heatmap %>%
  complete(
    facility_country = all_countries,
    item = infra_names,
    fill = list(
      n_facilities = 0L,
      n_consistently = 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = if_else(
      n_facilities > 0,
      100 * n_consistently / n_facilities,
      NA_real_
    ),

    # Percentage with numerator and denominator
    cell_label = if_else(
      is.na(percent),
      "NR",
      sprintf(
        "%.1f%%\n(%s/%s)",
        percent,
        n_consistently,
        n_facilities
      )
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Order countries by mean consistent availability
# ------------------------------------------------------------

country_order <- infra_valid %>%
  group_by(facility_country, facility_name) %>%
  summarise(
    pct_consistently = 100 * mean(
      availability == "consistently"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(facility_country) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pct = mean(pct_consistently),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_pct)) %>%
  pull(facility_country)

# Include countries without valid classifications
country_order <- c(
  country_order,
  setdiff(all_countries, country_order)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Order infrastructure by overall consistent availability
# ------------------------------------------------------------

infrastructure_order <- infra_valid %>%
  group_by(item) %>%
  summarise(
    percent = 100 * mean(
      availability == "consistently"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(percent)) %>%
  pull(item)

# Include items with no valid classifications
infrastructure_order <- c(
  infrastructure_order,
  setdiff(infra_names, infrastructure_order)
)

# Apply factor ordering
infra_country_heatmap <- infra_country_heatmap %>%
  mutate(
    facility_country = factor(
      facility_country,
      levels = country_order
    ),

    item = factor(
      item,
      levels = rev(infrastructure_order)
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Create country-by-infrastructure heatmap
# ------------------------------------------------------------

infra_country_heatmap_plot <- ggplot(
  infra_country_heatmap,
  aes(
    x = facility_country,
    y = item,
    fill = percent
  )
) +

  # Heatmap tiles
  geom_tile(
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  # Percentage and facility count labels
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = cell_label,

      color = case_when(
        is.na(percent) ~ "grey50",
        percent == 0 ~ "grey50",
        percent >= 50 ~ "white",
        TRUE ~ "black"
      )
    ),
    size = 2.7,
    lineheight = 0.9,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_color_identity() +

  # YlOrRd gradient
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c(
      "white",
      RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "YlOrRd")
    ),
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    name = "Facilities (%)",
    na.value = "grey90"
  ) +

  # Country labels
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = function(x) {
      stringr::str_to_title(
        stringr::str_replace_all(x, "_", " ")
      )
    },
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  # Infrastructure labels
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = function(x) {
      stringr::str_wrap(
        dplyr::coalesce(
          unname(infrastructure_labels[x]),
          x
        ),
        width = 35
      )
    },
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Consistent Infrastructure Availability by Country",

    subtitle = paste(
      "Percentage of surveyed facilities with",
      "consistently available infrastructure"
    ),

    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,

    caption = paste(
      "Cells show percentage (n/N) of facilities with",
      "consistent availability.",
      "Facility classifications based on modal surgeon responses.",
      "Denominators include valid, unambiguous classifications.",
      "NR = no valid facility classifications."
    )
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 14
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 10,
      color = "grey40"
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 9
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 10
    ),

    axis.ticks = element_blank(),

    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    legend.position = "right",

    legend.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),

    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 9,
      color = "grey40",
      hjust = 0
    ),

    plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 10)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Display heatmap
# ------------------------------------------------------------

infra_country_heatmap_plot
```


### Critical Infrastrucutre Gaps

```{r}

# ============================================================
# FIGURE 7.3 — CRITICAL INFRASTRUCTURE GAPS
# Consistently Available vs. Not Available
# ============================================================

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define infrastructure variables and labels
# -------------------------------------------------------

infra_names <- df %>%
  select(starts_with("infra_")) %>%
  names()

infrastructure_labels <- c(
  "infra_electricity" = "Electricity",
  "infra_water" = "Running Water",
  "infra_oxygen" = "Oxygen Supply",
  "infra_blood_bank" = "Blood Bank",
  "infra_icu" = "Intensive Care Unit (ICU)",
  "infra_physio" = "Physiotherapy Services",
  "infra_ot_therapy" = "Occupational Therapy Services",
  "infra_histopath" = "Histopathology Services",
  "infra_xray" = "X-Ray",
  "infra_ultrasound" = "Ultrasound",
  "infra_ct" = "CT Scanner",
  "infra_dedicated_or" = "Dedicated Operating Room Time for PRS",
  "infra_temp_or" = "Temperature-Controlled Operating Room",
  "infra_warming" = "Patient Warming Devices"
)

availability_levels <- c(
  "consistently",
  "intermittently",
  "not_available"
)

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Calculate facility-level availability percentages
# -------------------------------------------------------

infra_gap_data <- infra_facility_summary %>%

  # Keep valid, unambiguous facility classifications
  filter(
    availability %in% availability_levels,
    item %in% infra_names
  ) %>%

  # Ensure one observation per facility and item
  distinct(
    facility_name,
    item,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%

  # Count facilities per availability category
  count(
    item,
    availability,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%

  # Include zero-count categories
  complete(
    item = infra_names,
    availability = availability_levels,
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%

  # Calculate percentages within each infrastructure item
  group_by(item) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),

    percent = if_else(
      total > 0,
      100 * n / total,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# View calculated data
infra_gap_data


# -------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Sort infrastructure by percentage not available
# -------------------------------------------------------

infrastructure_gap_order <- infra_gap_data %>%
  filter(availability == "not_available") %>%
  arrange(desc(percent), item) %>%
  pull(item)


# -------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Prepare diverging bar chart data
# -------------------------------------------------------

infra_diverging_data <- infra_gap_data %>%

  # Display only consistently and not available
  filter(
    availability %in% c(
      "consistently",
      "not_available"
    )
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    # Negative percentages extend left
    plot_percent = if_else(
      availability == "not_available",
      -percent,
      percent
    ),

    # Availability labels
    availability_label = case_when(
      availability == "not_available" ~
        "Not Available",

      availability == "consistently" ~
        "Consistently Available"
    ),

    # Labels with percentages and facility counts
    pct_label = if_else(
      is.na(percent),
      "NR",
      sprintf(
        "%.1f%% (%s/%s)",
        percent,
        n,
        total
      )
    ),

    # Order infrastructure from most unavailable to least
    item = factor(
      item,
      levels = rev(infrastructure_gap_order)
    )
  )

# View plotting data
infra_diverging_data


# -------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Create diverging horizontal bar chart
# -------------------------------------------------------

infra_gap_plot <- ggplot(
  infra_diverging_data,
  aes(
    x = plot_percent,
    y = item,
    fill = availability_label
  )
) +

  # Horizontal bars
  geom_col(
    width = 0.7,
    position = "identity",
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  # Percentage and facility count labels
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = pct_label,
      hjust = if_else(
        availability == "not_available",
        1.08,
        -0.08
      )
    ),
    size = 3.2,
    color = "black",
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  # Center reference line
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    color = "grey40",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  # Red and green colors
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not Available" = "#C0392B",
      "Consistently Available" = "#2E8B57"
    ),
    breaks = c(
      "Not Available",
      "Consistently Available"
    )
  ) +

  # Symmetrical percentage axis
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(-100, 100, by = 25),
    labels = function(x) {
      paste0(abs(x), "%")
    }
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(-125, 125),
    clip = "off"
  ) +

  # Infrastructure names
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = function(x) {
      stringr::str_wrap(
        dplyr::coalesce(
          unname(infrastructure_labels[x]),
          x
        ),
        width = 35
      )
    },
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  # Titles and captions
  labs(
    title = "Critical Infrastructure Gaps",

    subtitle = paste(
      "Consistently available versus unavailable",
      "infrastructure across surveyed facilities"
    ),

    x = "Percentage of Facilities",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL,

    caption = paste(
      "Percentages are based on facility-level modal",
      "surgeon responses.",
      "Intermittently available infrastructure is included",
      "in denominators but not displayed.",
      "Missing and tied classifications are excluded.",
      "Labels show percentage (n/N)."
    )
  ) +

  # General theme
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 14
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 10,
      color = "grey40"
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 10
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 10
    ),

    axis.ticks = element_blank(),

    axis.title.y = element_blank(),

    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    legend.position = "top",

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 10
    ),

    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 9,
      color = "grey40",
      hjust = 0
    ),

    plot.margin = margin(10, 40, 10, 10)
  )


# -------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Display figure
# -------------------------------------------------------

infra_gap_plot


# -------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Save figure
# -------------------------------------------------------

output_dir <- here::here("images")

dir.create(
  output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    output_dir,
    "figure_7_3_critical_infrastructure_gaps.png"
  ),
  plot = infra_gap_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 9,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

#### By country

```{r}

# ============================================================
# CRITICAL INFRASTRUCTURE GAPS BY COUNTRY
# One diverging bar chart per country
# ============================================================

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare country-specific infrastructure data
# -------------------------------------------------------

availability_levels <- c(
  "consistently",
  "intermittently",
  "not_available"
)

# Count facility-level availability classifications
infra_country_gap_data <- infra_facility_country %>%
  mutate(
    facility_country = str_squish(
      as.character(facility_country)
    ),
    availability = as.character(availability)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(facility_country),
    facility_country != "",
    item %in% infra_names,
    availability %in% availability_levels
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    facility_country,
    facility_name,
    item,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  count(
    facility_country,
    item,
    availability,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  complete(
    nesting(facility_country),
    item = infra_names,
    availability = availability_levels,
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(facility_country, item) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    percent = if_else(
      total > 0,
      100 * n / total,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# -------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Function to create a plot for one country
# -------------------------------------------------------

plot_country_infra_gap <- function(country_name) {

  # Filter selected country
  country_data <- infra_country_gap_data %>%
    filter(facility_country == country_name)

  if (nrow(country_data) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No data found for", country_name))
  }

  # Number of unique facilities in this country
  n_facilities <- infra_facility_country %>%
    filter(facility_country == country_name) %>%
    summarise(n = n_distinct(facility_name)) %>%
    pull(n)

  # Order infrastructure by % not available
  infrastructure_order <- country_data %>%
    filter(availability == "not_available") %>%
    arrange(desc(percent), item) %>%
    pull(item)

  # Prepare diverging data
  plot_data <- country_data %>%
    filter(
      availability %in% c(
        "not_available",
        "consistently"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      plot_percent = if_else(
        availability == "not_available",
        -percent,
        percent
      ),

      availability_label = case_when(
        availability == "not_available" ~
          "Not Available",
        availability == "consistently" ~
          "Consistently Available"
      ),

      pct_label = if_else(
        is.na(percent),
        "NR",
        sprintf(
          "%.1f%% (%s/%s)",
          percent,
          n,
          total
        )
      ),

      item = factor(
        item,
        levels = rev(infrastructure_order)
      )
    )

  # Create diverging horizontal bar chart
  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = plot_percent,
      y = item,
      fill = availability_label
    )
  ) +

    geom_col(
      width = 0.7,
      position = "identity",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = pct_label,
        hjust = if_else(
          availability == "not_available",
          1.08,
          -0.08
        )
      ),
      size = 3,
      color = "black"
    ) +

    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      color = "grey40",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Not Available" = "#C0392B",
        "Consistently Available" = "#2E8B57"
      ),
      breaks = c(
        "Not Available",
        "Consistently Available"
      )
    ) +

    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(-100, 100, by = 25),
      labels = function(x) paste0(abs(x), "%")
    ) +

    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(-125, 125),
      clip = "off"
    ) +

    scale_y_discrete(
      labels = function(x) {
        stringr::str_wrap(
          dplyr::coalesce(
            unname(infrastructure_labels[x]),
            x
          ),
          width = 35
        )
      },
      drop = FALSE
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste(
        "Critical Infrastructure Gaps —",
        country_name
      ),

      subtitle = paste0(
        "Consistently available vs. not available (N = ",
        n_facilities,
        " facilities)"
      ),

      x = "Percentage of Facilities",
      y = NULL,
      fill = NULL,

      caption = paste(
        "Facility-level modal surgeon responses.",
        "Intermittently available resources included",
        "in denominators but not displayed.",
        "Missing and tied classifications excluded.",
        "Labels show percentage (n/N)."
      )
    ) +

    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 14
      ),

      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 10,
        color = "grey40"
      ),

      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 10
      ),

      axis.ticks = element_blank(),

      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

      legend.position = "top",

      plot.caption = element_text(
        size = 9,
        color = "grey40",
        hjust = 0
      ),

      plot.margin = margin(10, 40, 10, 10)
    )
}


# -------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Get all countries
# -------------------------------------------------------

countries <- infra_country_gap_data %>%
  distinct(facility_country) %>%
  pull(facility_country)


# -------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Create individual plots for every country
# -------------------------------------------------------

country_infra_gap_plots <- setNames(
  lapply(countries, plot_country_infra_gap),
  countries
)


# -------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Display a specific country
# -------------------------------------------------------

# View all country names
names(country_infra_gap_plots)

# Example
# print(country_infra_gap_plots[["Kenya"]])

# Or call the function directly
# plot_country_infra_gap("Kenya")


# -------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Save all country-specific plots
# -------------------------------------------------------

# Define output directory
output_dir <- here(
  "images",
  "country_infrastructure_gaps"
)

# Create folder if it doesn't exist
dir.create(
  output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# Save one figure per country
for (country in countries) {

  filename <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(
      gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", country),

    )

    filename = filename,
    plot = country_infra_gap_plots[[country]],
    width = 12,
    height = 9,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )
}
```

```{r calculate_heatmap include=F}
      levels = rev(equipment_order)
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define equipment groups

equipment_groups <- c(
  # Essential equipment and supplies
  "eq_burn_dressings"   = "Essential",

  "eq_catheters"        = "Essential",
  "eq_tourniquets"      = "Essential",
  "eq_splinting"        = "Essential",

  # PRS-specific equipment
  "eq_dermatome"        = "PRS-specific",
  "eq_skin_mesher"      = "PRS-specific",
  "eq_loupes"           = "PRS-specific",
  "eq_microsurgical"    = "PRS-specific",

  # Advanced equipment
  "eq_microscope"       = "Advanced",
  "eq_npwt"             = "Advanced",
  "eq_skin_substitutes" = "Advanced",

# Create equipment classification dataframe
equipment_classification <- tibble(
```

```{r}

# -------------------------------------------------------
# Function: Calculate equipment availability percentages
# -------------------------------------------------------

calculate_equipment_availability <- function(
    data,
    country_name = NULL
) {

  # Filter by country if specified
  if (!is.null(country_name)) {
    data <- data %>%
      filter(facility_country == country_name)
  }

  if (nrow(data) == 0) {
    stop("No equipment data found.")
  }

  # Calculate availability for each equipment item
  equipment_summary <- data %>%
    filter(item %in% equipment_classification$item) %>%
    group_by(item) %>%
    summarise(
      n_facilities = n_distinct(
        facility_name[
          availability %in% c(
            "consistently",
            "intermittently",
            "not_available"
          )
        ]
      ),

      n_consistently = n_distinct(
        facility_name[
          availability == "consistently"
        ]
      ),

      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Combine classification and results
  equipment_classification %>%
    left_join(
      equipment_summary,
      by = "item"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      n_facilities = replace_na(n_facilities, 0L),
      n_consistently = replace_na(n_consistently, 0L),

      percent = if_else(
        n_facilities > 0,
        100 * n_consistently / n_facilities,
        NA_real_
      ),

      pct_label = if_else(
        is.na(percent),
        "NR",
        sprintf(
          "%.1f%% (%s/%s)",
          percent,
          n_consistently,
          n_facilities
        )
      )
    )
}

```

```{r}

# -------------------------------------------------------
# Function: Plot equipment availability
# -------------------------------------------------------

plot_equipment_availability <- function(
    equipment_data,
    title,
    subtitle
) {

  # Order equipment within each group
  equipment_data <- equipment_data %>%
    arrange(group, desc(percent), item) %>%
    mutate(
      item = factor(
        item,
        levels = rev(item)
      )
    )

  # Create grouped horizontal bar chart
  ggplot(
    equipment_data,
    aes(
      x = percent,
      y = item,
      fill = percent
    )
  ) +

    geom_col(
      width = 0.75,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    # Percentages and facility counts
    geom_text(
      aes(
        x = if_else(
          is.na(percent),
          2,
          percent + 2
        ),
        label = pct_label
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      size = 3.2,
      color = "black"
    ) +

    # Same YlOrRd theme
    scale_fill_distiller(
      palette = "YlOrRd",
      direction = 1,
      limits = c(0, 100)
    ) +

    # Percent axis
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
      labels = label_number(suffix = "%")
    ) +

    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(0, 125),
      clip = "off"
    ) +

    # Equipment labels
    scale_y_discrete(
      labels = function(x) {
        stringr::str_wrap(
          dplyr::coalesce(
            unname(equipment_labels[x]),
            x
          ),
          width = 35
        )
      }
    ) +

    # Group equipment into three sections
    facet_grid(
      rows = vars(group),
      scales = "free_y",
      space = "free_y",
      switch = "y"
    ) +

    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = "Facilities with Consistent Availability (%)",
      y = NULL,
      fill = NULL,
      caption = paste(
        "Percentages calculated among facilities with valid,",
        "unambiguous item-level classifications.",
        "Facility availability based on modal surgeon responses.",
        "Labels show percentage (n/N). NR = no valid classifications."
      )
    ) +

    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 14
      ),

      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        color = "grey40",
        size = 10
      ),

      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 10
      ),

      axis.ticks = element_blank(),

      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

      strip.text.y.left = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 11
      ),

      strip.placement = "outside",

      panel.spacing.y = unit(1.2, "lines"),

      legend.position = "none",

      plot.caption = element_text(
        size = 9,
        color = "grey40",
        hjust = 0
      ),

      plot.margin = margin(10, 45, 10, 10)
    )
}
```

# EQUIPMENT & SUPPLIES (FACILITY LEVEL)

## Availability

```{r}

# Availability categories
availability_levels <- c(
  "consistently",
  "intermittently",
  "not_available"
)


# -------------------------------------------------------
# Function: Aggregate surgeon responses by facility
# -------------------------------------------------------

aggregate_facility_availability <- function(
    data,
    variables,
    facility_var = "main_facility_name"
) {

  # Check required columns
  required <- c(variables, facility_var)

  if (!all(required %in% names(data))) {
    stop(
      "Missing columns: ",
      paste(setdiff(required, names(data)), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # Convert surgeon responses into long format
  long_data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      facility_name = str_squish(
        as.character(.data[[facility_var]])
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(facility_name),
      facility_name != ""
    ) %>%
    select(
      facility_name,
      all_of(variables)
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(variables),
      names_to = "item",
      values_to = "frequency"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      frequency = str_squish(
        str_to_lower(as.character(frequency))
      ),
      frequency = str_replace_all(
        frequency, "\\s+", "_"
      ),
      frequency = na_if(frequency, "")
    )

  # Check unexpected response categories
  unknown <- setdiff(
    unique(na.omit(long_data$frequency)),
    availability_levels
  )

  if (length(unknown) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Unrecognized availability responses: ",
      paste(unknown, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # Count valid surgeon responses by facility and item
  facility_counts <- long_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(frequency)) %>%
    count(
      facility_name,
      item,
      frequency,
      name = "n"
    )

  # Assign most frequently reported availability
  facility_summary <- facility_counts %>%
    group_by(
      facility_name,
      item
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      n_surgeons = sum(n),

      agreement_pct = 100 * max(n) / sum(n),

      availability = if (
        sum(n == max(n)) == 1
      ) {
        frequency[which.max(n)]
      } else {
        "no_consensus"
      },

      .groups = "drop"
    )

  return(facility_summary)
}

```

### Calculate

```{r}

# -------------------------------------------------------
# Function: Calculate facility-level availability %
# -------------------------------------------------------

calculate_facility_heatmap <- function(facility_data) {

  # Exclude tied responses from the three-category
  # heatmap denominator
  heatmap_data <- facility_data %>%
    filter(
      availability %in% availability_levels
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      frequency = factor(
        availability,
        levels = availability_levels
      )
    ) %>%
    count(item, frequency, name = "n") %>%
    complete(
      item,
      frequency = factor(
        availability_levels,
        levels = availability_levels
      ),
      fill = list(n = 0)
    ) %>%
    group_by(item) %>%
    mutate(
      total = sum(n),
      percent = if_else(
        total > 0,
        100 * n / total,
        NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Order items by consistently available %
  item_order <- heatmap_data %>%
    filter(frequency == "consistently") %>%
    arrange(desc(percent)) %>%
    pull(item)

  heatmap_data %>%
    mutate(
      item = factor(
        item,
        levels = rev(item_order)
      )
    )
}

# Infrastructure heatmap data
# -------------------------------------------------------

  infra_facility_summary
)


# -------------------------------------------------------
# Equipment heatmap data
# -------------------------------------------------------

  eq_facility_summary
)
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------------
# Function: Plot facility-level availability heatmap
# -------------------------------------------------------

plot_facility_heatmap <- function(
    heatmap_data,
    item_labels,
    title
) {

  ggplot(
    heatmap_data,
    aes(
      x = frequency,
      y = item,
      fill = percent
    )
  ) +
    geom_tile(
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = if_else(
          is.na(percent),
          "NR",
          sprintf("%.1f%%", percent)
        ),
        color = case_when(
          is.na(percent) ~ "grey50",
          percent == 0 ~ "grey50",
          percent >= 50 ~ "white",
          TRUE ~ "black"
        )
      ),
      size = 3.5,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = c(
        "white",
        RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "YlOrRd")
      ),
      limits = c(0, 100),
      breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
      labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
      name = "Facilities (%)",
      na.value = "grey90"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      labels = c(
        "Consistently",
        "Intermittently",
        "Not Available"
      )
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(
      labels = function(x) {
        dplyr::coalesce(
          unname(item_labels[x]),
          x
        )
      }
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = paste(
        "Facility-level availability based on",
        "the most commonly reported surgeon response"
      ),
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      caption = paste(
        "Percentages calculated among facilities with",
        "valid, unambiguous classifications for each item.",
        "Tied responses excluded. NR = no classified facilities."
      )
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 10,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.caption = element_text(
        size = 9,
        color = "grey40",
        hjust = 0
      ),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}
```

# TRAINING

## Table - Training Capacity at Facilities

```{r}

# ============================================================
# SECTION 8 — TRAINING CAPACITY AND NEEDS
# ============================================================

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Training variables
# -------------------------------------------------------

training_vars <- c(
  "trains_residents",
  "hosts_outreach",
  "cpd_available"
)

training_labels <- c(
  "trains_residents" = "Trains PRS Residents/Fellows",
  "hosts_outreach" = "Hosts Visiting Outreach Teams",
  "cpd_available" = "Continuing Professional Development Opportunities Available"
)

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Create facility characteristics lookup
# -------------------------------------------------------

facility_training_lookup <- facility_df %>%
  transmute(
    facility_name = str_squish(
      as.character(facility_name)
    ),
    facility_country = na_if(
      str_squish(as.character(facility_country)), ""
    ),
    facility_level = na_if(
      str_squish(as.character(facility_level)), ""
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(facility_name),
    facility_name != ""
  ) %>%
  group_by(facility_name) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      c(facility_country, facility_level),
      ~ {
        values <- unique(.x[!is.na(.x)])
        if (length(values) > 1) {
          stop("Conflicting facility characteristics found.")
        }
        if (length(values) == 0) {
          NA_character_
        } else {
          values[1]
        }
      }
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Convert surgeon training responses to long format
# -------------------------------------------------------

training_long <- df %>%
  mutate(
    facility_name = str_squish(
      as.character(main_facility_name)
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(facility_name),
    facility_name != ""
  ) %>%
  select(
    facility_name,
    all_of(training_vars)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(training_vars),
    names_to = "training_indicator",
    values_to = "response"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    response = str_to_lower(
      str_squish(as.character(response))
    ),
    response = na_if(response, ""),
    response = if_else(
      response %in% c("yes", "no"),
      response,
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Aggregate surgeon responses by facility
# -------------------------------------------------------

training_facility <- training_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(response)) %>%
  count(
    facility_name,
    training_indicator,
    response,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    facility_name,
    training_indicator
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_surgeons = sum(n),

    agreement_pct = 100 * max(n) / sum(n),

    availability = if (
      sum(n == max(n)) == 1
    ) {
      response[which.max(n)]
    } else {
      "no_consensus"
    },

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    facility_training_lookup,
    by = "facility_name",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

# View facility-level responses
training_facility

```


```{r}


# ============================================================
# TABLE 8.1 — TRAINING CAPACITY AT FACILITIES
# ============================================================

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Function to summarize training capacity
# -------------------------------------------------------

summarise_training_capacity <- function(
    data,
    section_label
) {

  data %>%
    group_by(training_indicator) %>%
    summarise(
      yes_n = sum(availability == "yes"),
      no_n = sum(availability == "no"),

      total = yes_n + no_n,

      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    right_join(
      tibble(training_indicator = training_vars),
      by = "training_indicator"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        c(yes_n, no_n, total),
        ~ replace_na(.x, 0L)
      ),

      Section = section_label,

      Indicator = unname(
        training_labels[training_indicator]
      ),

      `Yes N (%)` = if_else(
        total > 0,
        sprintf(
          "%s (%.1f%%)",
          yes_n,
          100 * yes_n / pmax(total, 1)
        ),
        "NR"
      ),

      `No N (%)` = if_else(
        total > 0,
        sprintf(
          "%s (%.1f%%)",
          no_n,
          100 * no_n / pmax(total, 1)
        ),
        "NR"
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      Section,
      Indicator,
      `Yes N (%)`,
      `No N (%)`
    )
}


# -------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Overall summary
# -------------------------------------------------------

training_overall <- summarise_training_capacity(
  training_facility,
  "Overall"
)


# -------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Summary by facility level
# -------------------------------------------------------

training_by_level <- training_facility %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(facility_level),
    facility_level != ""
  ) %>%
  group_split(facility_level) %>%
  map_dfr(function(x) {

    summarise_training_capacity(
      x,
      paste0(
        "Facility Level: ",
        unique(x$facility_level)[1]
      )
    )
  })


# -------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Summary by country
# -------------------------------------------------------

training_by_country <- training_facility %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(facility_country),
    facility_country != ""
  ) %>%
  group_split(facility_country) %>%
  map_dfr(function(x) {

    summarise_training_capacity(
      x,
      paste0(
        "Country: ",
        unique(x$facility_country)[1]
      )
    )
  })


# -------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Combine sections
# -------------------------------------------------------

training_table_data <- bind_rows(
  training_overall,
  training_by_level,
  training_by_country
)


# -------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Create gt table
# -------------------------------------------------------

gt_training_capacity <- training_table_data %>%
  gt(
    rowname_col = "Indicator",
    groupname_col = "Section"
  ) %>%

  tab_header(
    title = md("**Training Capacity at Facilities**"),
    subtitle = "Overall and stratified by facility level and country"
  ) %>%

  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_row_groups()
  ) %>%

  cols_align(
    align = "right",
    columns = c(
      `Yes N (%)`,
      `No N (%)`
    )
  ) %>%

  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(13),
    data_row.padding = px(6),
    row_group.background.color = "#F2F4F6",
    table.border.top.color = "grey70",
    table.border.bottom.color = "grey70"
  ) %>%

  tab_source_note(
    source_note = md(
      paste(
        "Percentages calculated among facilities",
        "with valid, unambiguous classifications",
        "for each training indicator.",
        "Tied and missing responses excluded.",
        "NR = no valid classified facilities."
      )
    )
  )

# Display table
gt_training_capacity
```
