```{r}


# ============================================================
# FIGURE 8.1 — TRAINING CAPACITY BY COUNTRY
# ============================================================

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Calculate country percentages
# -------------------------------------------------------

training_country_summary <- training_facility %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(facility_country),
    facility_country != "",
    availability %in% c("yes", "no")
  ) %>%

  group_by(
    facility_country,
    training_indicator
  ) %>%

  summarise(
    n_yes = sum(availability == "yes"),
    n_facilities = n_distinct(facility_name),

    percent = 100 * n_yes / n_facilities,

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    training_label = factor(
      unname(training_labels[training_indicator]),
      levels = unname(training_labels[training_vars])
    ),

    pct_label = sprintf("%.1f%%", percent)
  )

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Order countries by mean training capacity
# -------------------------------------------------------

country_order <- training_country_summary %>%
  group_by(facility_country) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_percent = mean(percent),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_percent)) %>%
  pull(facility_country)

training_country_summary <- training_country_summary %>%
  mutate(
    facility_country = factor(
      facility_country,
      levels = country_order
    )
  )


# -------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Create grouped bar chart
# -------------------------------------------------------

training_country_bar <- ggplot(
  training_country_summary,
  aes(
    x = facility_country,
    y = percent,
    fill = training_label
  )
) +

  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7
  ) +

  geom_text(
    aes(label = pct_label),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 2.7
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Trains PRS Residents/Fellows" = "#BD0026",
      "Hosts Visiting Outreach Teams" = "#FD8D3C",
      "CPD Opportunities Available" = "#FEB24C"
    )
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
    labels = label_number(suffix = "%")
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0, 110),
    clip = "off"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Training Capacity by Country",
    subtitle = "Facility-level training opportunities across surveyed countries",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Facilities reporting Yes (%)",
    fill = NULL,

    caption = paste(
      "Percentages calculated among facilities with valid",
      "and unambiguous responses for each indicator.",
      "Facility classifications based on modal surgeon reports."
    )
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 13
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),

    axis.ticks = element_blank(),

    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    legend.position = "top",

    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 9,
      color = "grey40",
      hjust = 0
    )
  )

# Display figure
training_country_bar


```

## Training Needs Reported

```{r}

# ============================================================
# FIGURE 8.2A — TRAINING NEEDS REPORTED (Q37)
# ============================================================

# Prepare surgeon-level responses
training_needs_data <- df %>%
  mutate(
    respondent_row = row_number(),

    training_needs = str_to_lower(
      str_squish(as.character(training_needs))
    ),

    training_needs = na_if(training_needs, "")
  )

# Count valid Q37 responses
training_needs_summary <- training_needs_data %>%
  filter(training_needs %in% c("yes", "no")) %>%
  count(training_needs, name = "n") %>%
  complete(
    training_needs = c("yes", "no"),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = 100 * n / sum(n),

    response_label = factor(
      if_else(training_needs == "yes", "Yes", "No"),
      levels = c("Yes", "No")
    ),

    pct_label = sprintf(
      "%.1f%%\n(n = %s)",
      percent,
      n
    )
  )

# Total valid Q37 respondents
n_training_respondents <- sum(training_needs_summary$n)

# Create donut chart
training_needs_donut <- ggplot(
  training_needs_summary,
  aes(
    x = 2,
    y = n,
    fill = response_label
  )
) +

  geom_col(
    width = 1,
    color = "white"
  ) +

  coord_polar(theta = "y") +

  xlim(0.5, 2.5) +

  geom_text(
    aes(label = pct_label),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3.5,
    color = "white"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Yes" = "#BD0026",
      "No" = "#FEB24C"
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Additional Training Needs",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Surgeon-reported needs (N = ",
      n_training_respondents,
      ")"
    ),
    fill = NULL
  ) +

  theme_void(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

training_needs_donut
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Match coded training needs to surgeon country
# -------------------------------------------------------

# Create surgeon-country lookup using actual IDs
surgeon_country_lookup <- df %>%
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id),
    main_facility_name = str_squish(
      as.character(main_facility_name)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(id, main_facility_name) %>%
  left_join(
    facility_country_lookup %>%
      select(facility_name, facility_country),
    by = c("main_facility_name" = "facility_name"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Add country to coded training needs
training_needs_country <- training_needs_coded %>%
  mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>%
  left_join(
    surgeon_country_lookup %>%
      select(id, facility_country),
    by = "id",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

# Check unmatched countries
training_needs_country %>%
  filter(is.na(facility_country)) %>%
  select(id, training_needs_specify)
```
```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Prepare country-specific theme frequencies
# -------------------------------------------------------

# Count unique surgeons with valid Q38 responses by country
country_training_respondents <- training_needs_country %>%
  mutate(
    facility_country = str_squish(
      as.character(facility_country)
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(facility_country),
    facility_country != "",
    !is.na(training_needs_specify),
    str_squish(training_needs_specify) != ""
  ) %>%
  group_by(facility_country) %>%
  summarise(
    total_respondents = n_distinct(id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Separate multiple themes into individual rows
training_themes_country_long <- training_needs_country %>%
  mutate(
    facility_country = str_squish(
      as.character(facility_country)
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(facility_country),
    facility_country != "",
    !is.na(theme),
    theme != ""
  ) %>%
  separate_rows(
    theme,
    sep = ";"
  ) %>%
  mutate(theme = str_squish(theme)) %>%
  filter(theme != "") %>%
  distinct(id, facility_country, theme)

# Calculate country percentages
training_theme_country_count <- training_themes_country_long %>%
  count(
    facility_country,
    theme,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    country_training_respondents,
    by = "facility_country"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = 100 * n / total_respondents,
    pct_label = sprintf(
      "%.1f%% (n = %s)",
      percentage,
      n
    )
  )

# View data
training_theme_country_count
```


```{r}

# -------------------------------------------------------
# Function: Training needs by country
# -------------------------------------------------------

plot_country_training_needs <- function(country_name) {

  # Filter data for selected country
  country_data <- training_theme_country_count %>%
    filter(facility_country == country_name)

  if (nrow(country_data) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No training needs data found for", country_name))
  }

  # Number of surgeons providing valid Q38 responses
  n_surgeons <- country_data %>%
    summarise(
      n = first(total_respondents)
    ) %>%
    pull(n)

  # Prepare theme ordering
  country_data <- country_data %>%
    mutate(
      theme_ordered = reorder(theme, percentage)
    )

  # Create horizontal bar chart
  ggplot(
    country_data,
    aes(
      x = theme_ordered,
      y = percentage,
      fill = percentage
    )
  ) +

    geom_col(
      width = 0.75
    ) +

    # Percentage labels inside bars
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = pct_label,
        hjust = if_else(
          percentage >= 70,
          1.1,
          -0.1
        ),
        color = case_when(
          percentage >= 70 ~ "white",
          TRUE ~ "black"
        )
      ),
      size = 3.2,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +

    scale_color_identity() +

    # Fixed color gradient across all countries
    scale_fill_distiller(
      palette = "YlOrRd",
      direction = 1,
      limits = c(0, 100),
      breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100)
    ) +

    scale_x_discrete(
      labels = function(x) {
        str_wrap(x, width = 28)
      }
    ) +

    # Percentage axis from 0 to 100%
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
      labels = label_number(suffix = "%"),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +

    coord_flip(
      ylim = c(0, 100),
      clip = "off"
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste(
        "Training Needs by Theme —",
        country_name
      ),

      subtitle = paste0(
        "Surgeon-reported training needs (N = ",
        n_surgeons,
        ")"
      ),

      x = NULL,
      y = "% of respondents reporting each theme",

      caption = paste(
        "Multiple themes permitted per respondent.",
        "Percentages calculated among surgeons providing",
        "valid free-text responses within each country."
      )
    ) +

    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 13
      ),

      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),

      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

      legend.position = "none",

      plot.caption = element_text(
        size = 9,
        color = "grey40",
        hjust = 0
      ),

      plot.margin = margin(10, 40, 10, 10)
    )
}


# -------------------------------------------------------
# Get all countries
# -------------------------------------------------------

countries <- training_theme_country_count %>%
  distinct(facility_country) %>%
  pull(facility_country)

# -------------------------------------------------------
# Create individual plots for every country
# -------------------------------------------------------

country_training_needs_plots <- setNames(
  lapply(countries, plot_country_training_needs),
  countries
)
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------------
# Save one training needs figure per country
# -------------------------------------------------------

output_dir <- here(
  "images",
  "country_training_needs"
)

dir.create(
  output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

for (country in countries) {

  filename <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(
      gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", country),
      "_training_needs.png"
    )
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = filename,
    plot = country_training_needs_plots[[country]],
    width = 12,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )
}
```
